text:
Littlelands - Official Early Access Launch Trailer
Littlelands is available now in Steam Early Access for Windows PC. Step into the vibrant, cute world of Littlelands in this early access launch trailer for the adventure game that blends cozy life simulation with classic action-adventure.

In Littlelands, even the smallest discoveries can lead to unforgettable adventures.

Explore a colorful region brimming with curious creatures, hidden pathways, mysterious ruins, and quirky inhabitants who might just need a helping hand. Take on quests, uncover secrets, and discover new places as you journey beyond the safety of town.

But adventure isn't always about swinging a sword.

Spend a peaceful afternoon fishing, catching insects, tending to your garden, or decorating your surroundings. Restore a farm, customize your character, and settle into a world where there's no pressure to rush from one adventure to the next.

Remain - Official Trailer (2027) Jake Gyllenhaal, Phoebe Dynevor
Check out the trailer for Remain, an upcoming film starring Jake Gyllenhaal, Phoebe Dynevor, Ashley Walters, Julie Hagerty, and Jay O. Sanders.

When reclusive architect Tate Gordon moves to small coastal town to complete his latest project, he encounters an alluring young woman who pulls him out of his shell, and into the center of a deadly mystery that hangs over the town.

 M. Night Shyamalan directs from his own screenplay, story by Shyamalan and Nicholas Sparks. The film is produced by Shyamalan, Ashwin Rajan, Marc Bienstock and Theresa Park, with Sparks executive producing.

Warner Bros. Pictures Presents a Blinding Edge Pictures Production, an M. Night Shyamalan Film, Remain, in theaters across North America February 5, 2027, and internationally beginning 3 February 2027, distributed by Warner Bros. Pictures.

author: IGN YouTube
text:
Robert Pattinson Is the New James Bond 007 - IGN Daily Fix
In today's Daily Fix:
The search for the next 007 is over as Amazon has selected Robert Pattinson to take over from Daniel Craig in Bond 26. Pattinson beat out several other hopefuls for James Bond including Callum Turner and Nicholas Hoult, and has reportedly signed a three-movie deal to play Bond. He will next be seen in Dune: Part Three, also directed by Bond 26 director Denis Villeneuve. In other news, Xbox has confirmed the next-gen Project Helix will play PC games, but that it will be a gaming console first, instead of a PC that plays console games. And finally, EA knows you will likely need to make room on your hard drive for GTA 6, but they don't want you to delete Madden NFL 27. The company is planning an update for tomorrow, November 17th, and likely doesn't want player counts to drop on account of everyone making room for GTA 6's massive storage needs.

text:
I Play Rocky - Official I Play Rocky Clip (2026) Anthony Ippolito, AnnaSophia Robb, Matt Dillon
Don't miss the Official Trailer 2 for I Play Rocky, a dramatic biopic film distributed by Amazon MGM Studios. Sylvester Stallone becomes Rocky in I Play Rocky, in select theaters now and everywhere on November 20.

The film is an electrifying true story about an unknown actor with an unshakable belief that he wasn’t just meant to write Rocky—he was meant to be Rocky Balboa. Told “no” at every turn, Sylvester Stallone bets everything on himself, holding the line on playing the lead against seemingly impossible odds. The result is the ultimate underdog story behind the ultimate underdog movie.

I Play Rocky stars Anthony Ippolito, Matt Dillon, AnnaSophia Robb, P.J. Byrne, Toby Kebbell, Tracy Letts, Jay Duplass, Stephan James, Kiki Seto, Robert Morgan, Saul Stein, Trevor St. John, Erik Palladino, and Rob Demery. The film is directed by Peter Farrelly and produced by Toby Emmerich, Christian Baha, and Peter Farrelly.

I Play Rocky is in select theaters now and everywhere on November 20.

Focker-In-Law - Official A Look Inside Behind-the-Scenes (2026) Ben Stiller, Ariana Grande
Take a look at the A Look Inside Featurette for Focker-In-Law, the upcoming comedic film distributed by Universal Pictures. Take a look inside the next installment of the 2000 franchise, Focker-In-Law, in theaters on November 26.

This November, comedy icon and Emmy winner Ben Stiller and two-time Oscar winner Robert De Niro reunite, joined by Grammy winner and Oscar nominee Ariana Grande, in Focker-In-Law, a new chapter in the blockbuster Meet the Parents franchise. 

Written and directed by John Hamburg, who co-wrote the three previous Meet the Parents films, Focker-In-Law is produced by Oscar nominee Jane Rosenthal and Robert De Niro for Tribeca Productions; Ben Stiller and Oscar winner John Lesher for Red Hour Films.
